function.description: **NETWORK SERVER SETTINGS** : Retrieve DHCP settings for a site. For broad queries such as what network server settings are configured at a site, invoke this tool together with the AAA, DNS, image distribution, NTP, time zone, and banner settings tools to build a complete network server settings response. Use this tool for generic site-level DHCP configuration queries, including the configured DHCP servers, inherited DHCP settings, and the parent site from which DHCP settings are inherited. Example queries include: Which DHCP servers are configured for a site? Are DHCP settings for a site inherited? From which parent site? `null` values indicate that the setting will be inherited from the parent site; empty objects (`{}`) indicate that the setting is unset at a site.
function.name: api_retrieveDHCPSettingsForASite

_inherited.description: Include inherited DHCP settings from parent sites.

servers.description: DHCP servers for managing client device networking configuration.
